note: Turns the venture stage into behavior. The administration skill reads Overview.md's stage (reconciled with the real signals in references/lifecycle.md) and activates the matching row: the operating stage, the active playbook, the next required milestone, the departments to convene (each by its skill: finance-and-accounting, sales-and-marketing, legal-and-compliance and the rest, with research-and-development for product work), and the rigor and metrics defaults. A run on the Founder's own affairs has no stage; its stakes and its reversibility set the tier instead.

Idea.convene: CEO (strategy framing); a lens or two

Validation.next_milestone: evidence of real demand before building

Growth.convene: the relevant departments; sales-and-marketing owns the number
Growth.metrics: CAC payback, NRR, burn multiple, growth rate

Scaling.convene: every relevant department + the COO's execution plan
Scaling.metrics: Rule of 40, magic number, NRR, gross margin

Established.next_milestone: defend the core, fund the next S-curve
Established.metrics: Rule of 40, free cash flow, durable NRR, H2/H3 pipeline

Mature.convene: quarterly board; CEO on horizons; the COO on the portfolio
Mature.metrics: FCF and margin, reinvestment in R&D, H2/H3 health

Plateau.next_milestone: a funded next S-curve or a deliberate pivot

Decline.next_milestone: a turnaround plan or an orderly outcome
